sloka: स विह्वलं तदालक्ष्य दशग्रीवं ततो ऽर्जुनः ।सहसोत्पत्य जग्राह गरुत्मानिव पन्नगम् ।। ७.३२.६३ ॥
transliteration: sa vihvalaṁ tadālakṣya daśagrīvaṁ tato 'rjunaḥ ।sahasotpatya jagrāha garutmāniva pannagam ।। 7.32.63 ॥

translations.english: Perceiving Dashagriva to be bewildered, Arjuna then suddenly leaped up and seized him, just as Garuda seizes a serpent.
